title: SREV-107 driverassist host inject restart coalescing

scm_shape.description: Official SCM enumerate, control, and start-service shape

source_change.description: Minimal DriverAssist source change preserving HostInjectProcess restart policy

runtime_matrix.description: Windows SCM and host-injection runtime proof

contracts: each config update increments a generation counter
only one restart worker may be active at a time
the active worker waits for a 250ms quiet window before entering SCM work
the worker must not hold m_critSecHostInjectedSvcs while sleeping
SCM enumeration stop and start work runs under m_critSecHostInjectedSvcs
if a new generation appears while SCM work is running a worker must run another quiet-window pass
if another worker claims the new generation the current worker may exit
EnumServicesStatusExW enumerates services from an SCM database and requires SC_MANAGER_ENUMERATE_SERVICE
ControlService sends service control codes through SCM and SCM processes control notifications serially
StartServiceW starts services through SCM and can block when another service is handling a control code
this SREV must not change HostInjectProcess matching or service restart policy
